certified_native_observation_rule.certification: measured vs tick_count>0 on the fleet parity panel: 1680/1680 minutes agree (100.000%). Certified against the tick reference, NOT assumed.
certified_native_observation_rule.rule: native observed minute := native candle volume > 0 (per side)

concepts.CLOCK_MINUTE: regular M1 grid timestamp; may exist with no market observation
concepts.EXECUTABLE_QUOTE: session_valid AND both bid and ask observed
concepts.OBSERVED_MARKET_QUOTE: minute with genuine underlying tick observation

cross_pair_synchronization.default: contemporaneously observed prices only, unless a frozen family explicitly defines another causal synchronization rule.
cross_pair_synchronization.forbidden: treating a carry-forward quote as fresh merely because it shares a timestamp row (applies to triangular residuals, currency factors, cross-sectional momentum, cross-pair residuals, cointegration inputs).
cross_pair_synchronization.rule: a synchronized cross-pair/triangular observation at t requires EVERY leg observed at t (contemporaneous). A stale/imputed leg breaks synchronization.

execution_invariant.latency: frozen one-completed-M1 latency preserved; missing_quote_policy=no_synthetic_fill; never manufacture a fill at a carry-forward price.
execution_invariant.on_missing_quote: advance clock time to the next session-valid EXECUTABLE (observed bid+ask) minute; time advances but execution does not.
execution_invariant.rule: NO entry/exit/stop/target/mandatory-exit/delayed fill may execute on an imputed / non-observed minute.

feature_policy.rule: an imputed row does not update stateful market features and is NOT a zero market return.

imputation.carry_forward: no-observation minutes may carry a flat last-close bar for clock alignment (fill_session_grid).
imputation.staleness_minutes: minutes since the last observed quote (0 on observed minutes).

mtf_provenance.rule: M5/M15/H1 bars carry observed_minutes, imputed_minutes and coverage_fraction; N carry-forward minutes are NOT N independent market observations.

tick_observation_rule: tick observed minute := tick_count > 0 (from tick->M1 aggregation)

volume_use.forbidden: any V3 alpha feature; does NOT enable TICK_QUOTE_ARRIVAL_RATE capability.
